title: Thunderstorm wind reports
unit: reports a year per 1,000 sq mi of land
release: NOAA NCEI Storm Events Database, details files v1.0
geographyVintage: NOAA county codes joined by FIPS to 2021 Census counties; land area from the 2021 Census Gazetteer
citation: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information, Storm Events Database. https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/storm-events-database/
note: This value is the mean number of reports a year from 2006–2025, per 1,000 square miles of county land. Each report is one storm event in one county, as logged in NOAA's Storm Events Database. More reports come in where more people live and watch, so rural counties can read low. Winter, heat, high-wind and tropical storms are logged by forecast zone, not by county, so they are not counted here. Small independent cities have little land, so a few reports give a high rate. It is not a forecast. Source: NOAA NCEI Storm Events Database. NOAA does not endorse this atlas.
